contract.selective_unregister: Removing a middle listener removes only that callback
contract.remaining_order: Remaining callbacks retain their original registration order
contract.post_unregister_delivery: The removed callback receives no subsequent events
contract.remaining_delivery: Callbacks remaining in the registry continue receiving emitted events
contract.delivery_order: Remaining callbacks are delivered in their preserved registration order
contract.registry_stability: Selective removal followed by emit leaves the listener registry structurally consistent
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit continue to require the events permission
